topic: How to Make Lo‑Fi Content for AI UGC Ads in 2026: Imperfect by Design (Playbook + Templates)
title_locked: How to Make Lo‑Fi Content for AI UGC Ads in 2026: Imperfect by Design (Playbook + Templates)
title_alternatives: Lo‑Fi Content for AI UGC Ads (2026): 7-Step Playbook + Templates
How to Create Unpolished UGC-Style Ads with AI in 2026 (Checklist + Examples)
target_audience: Beginner creators and performance marketers producing short-form UGC-style ads (TikTok/Reels/Shorts) who want their AI-generated creatives to feel real, not overproduced.
article_angle: AI UGC often fails because it looks too perfect and therefore fake. This tutorial reframes "Lo‑Fi" as a deliberate design system (imperfections, handheld energy, imperfect editing) and provides a 7-step playbook, copy-paste templates, and a quality checklist to produce believable, testable UGC-style ads.

source.note: Use as conceptual + data support. Do not copy structure or wording.

must_include: Hero image placeholder (to be generated in edit phase)
Key Takeaways section immediately after H1
The 90-second answer (AIDA opening): first 50 words directly answer the title question; first 150 words include a data hook
Definitions: Lo-Fi content (and what it isn't), UGC ad, angle, proof, CTA
Why Lo-Fi works for UGC ads (with cited data from DashSocial and TikTok Creative Center)
7-step “Imperfect by Design” playbook (each step includes a copy-paste template and a checklist)
Prompt Structure section using the 7 essential prompt elements, with 2 complete prompt examples (Beginner + Pro)
At least 1 comparison table (Lo-Fi vs Hi-Fi, or Unpolished UGC vs Product Ad vs Combo)
CTA card at the end linking to /pages/videoGen
